# Description
AutoTorch is a Minecraft plugin designed to automatically place torches in dark areas, enhancing cave exploration and survival. Whether mining deep underground or navigating dark tunnels, AutoTorch ensures players never struggle with visibility again.


# ⚙️ Features

### ✅ Free Version
- Automatically places torches from your inventory when the light level is too low.
- Simple setup for administrators.
- Works in Survival and Adventure modes.
### Premium Version (Additional Features)
- Support for lanterns, glowstone, and redstone torches.
- Underwater mode – automatically places Soul Lanterns underwater.
- Smart placement – prevents excessive torch placement.
- Advanced settings (torch placement distance, light level, enabled worlds, etc.).
- /autotorch start and /autotorch stop to enable or disable AutoTorch for a player.
![at4](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e6e86b3e537a18f006d4949a7ed4ac99800a5d6.png)
# Installation
- Download the .jar file and place it in the /plugins/ folder on your server.
- Restart the server or use the /reload command.
- (Optional) Configure config.yml according to your preferences.
